title: 6 months after man’s murder, brother shot dead in Kurla

ai.summary: The Pawar family staged a protest in front of the Vinoba Bhave Nagar police station demanding a speedy investigation and arrest of suspects linked to their brother's murder six months earlier.

facts.claim: The Pawar family staged a protest in front of the Vinoba Bhave Nagar police station
facts.quote: Members of the deceased’s family staged a protest in front of the Vinoba Bhave Nagar police station, demanding a speedy probe and arrest of the accused

facts.claim: The protest was demanding a speedy investigation and arrest of suspects
facts.quote: demanding a speedy probe and arrest of the accused

facts.claim: The deceased was shot dead six months after his brother was killed
facts.quote: A 40-year-old man was shot dead near the Halav bridge in Kurla on Wednesday, around six months after his brother was killed in a similar attack

facts.claim: The deceased worked as a labour contractor and moneylender
facts.quote: the deceased, Vinod Mallappa Pawar, worked as a labour contractor and moneylender

facts.claim: The deceased had three offences registered against him, including a murder case
facts.quote: he had three offences registered against him, including a murder case

facts.claim: The police suspect the two murders are linked to an old dispute between the Pawar family and their distant relatives
facts.quote: the police suspect the two murders are linked to an old dispute between the Pawar family and their distant relatives

facts.claim: The police have identified four suspects in Wednesday’s murder
facts.quote: The police have identified four suspects in Wednesday’s murder

ai.background_note: The Pawar family has been involved in a series of murders linked to disputes with distant relatives, with the latest incident occurring six months after their brother's death.
